title: Probe into Error in Khoo Teck Puat Hospital's Laboratory Test for Cancer Patients
what_it_is: Probe into Error in Khoo Teck Puat Hospital's Laboratory Test for Cancer Patients

sections.label: Reclassified HER2 patients
sections.summary: As at 23 December 2020, 200 patients were reclassified from HER2 positive to HER2 negative, eight at private and 192 at Government hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As at 23 December 2020, 200 patients have been reclassified from HER2 positive to HER2 negative.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Of these, eight patients were treated at private hospitals and 192 patients at Government hospitals.

sections.label: Heart problems and refunds
sections.summary: About 3% to 4% of those who underwent HER2-directed treatment may experience heart problems, and the portion of bills from unnecessary treatment will be fully refunded.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: About 3% to 4% of those who underwent HER2-directed treatment, for example, using Herceptin, may also experience heart problems.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The portion of the bills which arose from the unnecessary treatment will be fully refunded.

sections.label: Supporting patients and other tests
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether authorities will compassionately support patients who had unnecessary treatment and whether improvements may affect other immunohistochemistry tests.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: The first is that in terms of supporting the patients, will the relevant authorities bear in mind that patients who undergo unnecessary treatment as a result of this unfortunate situation, some of these patients will have had to make recurrent visits to clinic, recurrent visits for treatment involving time-off work, care-givers taking time-off work – all of these with possible financial implications as well as implications for job security in the current COVID-19 climate.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: And I ask, will the Ministry, together with KTPH, consider this compassionately and holistically in supporting the patients who have gone through this?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: The second question to the Senior Minister of State is that even as the root cause analysis is on-going, can the Ministry assure us that we will also look at whether any areas of improvement may impinge on other immunohistochemistry tests that may have come out of that relevant laboratory?

sections.label: KTPH bears costs and refunds
sections.summary: KTPH has informed that costs and investigations resulting from Herceptin treatment will be borne by the hospital and refunds will be given.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: KTPH has informed that any costs, as well as investigations that are done as a result of Herceptin treatment will be borne by the hospital and refunds will be given.

sections.label: Tumour Board flagged higher positivity
sections.summary: The multi-disciplinary Tumour Board flagged that the positivity rate seemed higher than expected, and an expertise team is reviewing which process parts could be strengthened.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Because being a multi-step process, if we depend on one single point to validate its accuracy, then it will be at a very, very high risk of failure at some point of time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But fortunately, because there is an institutional process through the Tumour Board – a multi-disciplinary review board looking at tumour outcomes, specimen and treatment, it was flagged up at the point of review that the positivity rate seems to be higher than expected.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I would say that the processes are there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We now need to look at which part of this process could have been strengthened further and that is the on-going review that the expertise team is looking at, at the moment.

sections.label: Question on earlier trigger
sections.summary: The speaker asks why, given the specimens and processes in place, there was not an earlier trigger even if the first diagnosis was wrong.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Certainly, over the entire period of time, something must have been picked up even if the first diagnosis was supposed to be wrong.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: So, as the Senior Minister of State said, with all these specimens and also all the different processes that are in place, why was there not an earlier trigger?

sections.label: HER2 test false positivity rate
sections.summary: Early HER2 staining had false positivity as high as 19%, dropping to about 6% or less after 2007 guidelines, but never zero.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If I may quote from a paper in Journal of Clinical Oncology published in 2015, a British medical journal, it gives a background that early studies using this technique to look at HER2 staining has shown high false positivity rate, as high as 19% –	as high as 19% – in the early days when this test was started.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Over the years, after 2007, when a stronger push by the professionals to put out guidelines, that false positivity rate has now dropped to about 6% or less, but it is still present; it is never going to be zero.

sections.label: Refund of treatment costs
sections.summary: Treatment costs from a positive HER2 result, usually Herceptin, and related complications would be refunded.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: When it comes to the question of whether you are going to get compensation, as I said earlier, any treatment cost due to the treatment arising from a positive HER2 results, in other words, usually treatment with Herceptin as the drug, the cost of the drug likely would be refunded.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Any investigation or tests or treatment of any related complications as a result of, say, Herceptin, would also be refunded as well.

sections.label: 200 patients reclassified HER2 negative
sections.summary: 200 patients have been reclassified from HER2 positive to HER2 negative, giving them a better prognosis; those not contacted are okay.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I would want to give assurance and say that if you have not been contacted by your oncologist, it means you are okay.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Those who are affected, as I said in my reply, 200 patients so far have been reclassified from HER2 positive to HER2 negative.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In other words, these 200 patients from a poor prognosis tumour now has a better prognosis tumour, because HER2 positivity codes for a poorer prognosis to begin with.

sections.label: Cost varies by institution
sections.summary: The cost will vary from institution to institution.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The cost will vary from institution to institution.
